summary: Research complete for task 116. Report at specs/116_core_agent_system_consolidation/reports/01_orchestrate-centric-consolidation-design-inputs.md answers all 7 research questions from the delegation brief with file+line evidence. Key findings: (1) /orchestrate lacks --team, --hard/--fast, model flags, --clean, --force, --roadmap, and any phase-forcing/revision-with-reason mechanism at the command layer -- parse-command-args.sh already computes most of these but orchestrate.md never threads them into the Skill delegation context; (2) no phase-forcing flag mechanism exists today (skill-orchestrate's Stage 4 is purely status-driven), and next_artifact_number auto-increments for research only, not plan/implement, so forced re-plan/re-implement would currently collide on the same artifact number; (3) /orchestrate --hard has no dispatch site anywhere -- skill-orchestrate-hard is fully built and tested but unreachable; hard skill/agent pairs are structurally near-identical to base (comparable or smaller line counts), supporting cheap A4 contract-injection collapse; only 3/19 extension manifests declare routing_hard; (4) team mode has one historical use (task 36, skill-team-research only) and zero events.jsonl hits for team-plan/team-implement; (5) confirmed via grep; (6) most severe finding: skill-orchestrate dispatches agents directly via the Agent tool, bypassing skill-researcher/planner/implementer entirely -- those three skills are the ONLY place memory-retrieve.sh/clean_flag and the interactive --lit resolution (lit-stage4a-flow.md) live, so /orchestrate-driven tasks currently get zero memory context and --lit silently no-ops (threaded as a boolean, never resolved into a briefing); (7) a 32-task Phase B evidence table is included (file_scope, informal category, dependent A-item), with #68 (orchestrate blocked-verdict discrimination) and #81 (task-lock/session-registry heartbeat mechanization) flagged as additional BLOCKING candidates beyond the two the task description already named. Data gaps: tasks #45 and #46 have empty file_scope in state.json and could not be evidenced from state.json alone.
